blurb: Guests can rent Sea-Doo Spark jet skis, including two and three-seater models, to explore local islands and wildlife. Guided 90-minute jet ski tours include stops at Seashell Island with opportunities to swim and shell hunt. Rentals also include kayaks and stand up paddle boards (SUPs) for use inside the marina and bay.
